namespace curve25519_dalek.edwards.EdwardsPoint
open Edwards

/-- Field-level algebra behind `double`: the completed-point doubling formulas followed by
`as_extended` give a valid extended point representing `P + P`. -/
theorem double_field_math (P : Point Ed25519) (X Y Z cX cY cZ cT X' Y' Z' T' : CurveField)
    (hZ : Z ≠ 0) (hPx : P.x = X / Z) (hPy : P.y = Y / Z)
    (hcX : cX + Y ^ 2 + X ^ 2 = (X + Y) ^ 2) (hcY : cY = Y ^ 2 + X ^ 2)
    (hcZ : cZ + X ^ 2 = Y ^ 2) (hcT : cT + cZ = 2 * Z ^ 2)
    (hX' : X' = cX * cT) (hY' : Y' = cY * cZ) (hZ' : Z' = cZ * cT) (hT' : T' = cX * cY) :
    Z' ≠ 0 ∧ X' * Y' = T' * Z' ∧
    Ed25519.a * X' ^ 2 * Z' ^ 2 + Y' ^ 2 * Z' ^ 2 = Z' ^ 4 + Ed25519.d * X' ^ 2 * Y' ^ 2 ∧
    X' / Z' = (P + P).x ∧ Y' / Z' = (P + P).y := by
  have hX : X = P.x * Z := by rw [hPx]; field_simp
  have hY : Y = P.y * Z := by rw [hPy]; field_simp
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Ed25519.denomsNeZero P P
  have hc := P.on_curve
  have ha : Ed25519.a = -1 := rfl
  rw [ha] at hc
  subst hX hY
  have hcZ' : cZ = Z ^ 2 * (1 + Ed25519.d * P.x * P.x * P.y * P.y) := by
    linear_combination hcZ + Z ^ 2 * hc
  have hcT' : cT = Z ^ 2 * (1 - Ed25519.d * P.x * P.x * P.y * P.y) := by
    linear_combination hcT - hcZ'
  have hcX' : cX = 2 * P.x * P.y * Z ^ 2 := by linear_combination hcX
  have hZ'0 : Z' ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hZ', hcZ', hcT']
    exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hZ) h1) (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hZ) h2)
  have hx : X' / Z' = (P + P).x := by
    show _ = (P.x * P.y + P.y * P.x) / (1 + Ed25519.d * P.x * P.x * P.y * P.y)
    rw [hX', hZ', hcX', hcT', hcZ']
    field_simp
    ring
  have hy : Y' / Z' = (P + P).y := by
    show _ = (P.y * P.y - Ed25519.a * P.x * P.x) / (1 - Ed25519.d * P.x * P.x * P.y * P.y)
    rw [hY', hZ', hcY, hcT', hcZ', ha]
    field_simp
    ring
  refine ⟨hZ'0, by rw [hX', hY', hT', hZ']; ring, ?_, hx, hy⟩
  have hx' : X' = (P + P).x * Z' := by rw [← hx]; field_simp
  have hy' : Y' = (P + P).y * Z' := by rw [← hy]; field_simp
  have hc2 := (P + P).on_curve
  rw [hx', hy']
  linear_combination Z' ^ 4 * hc2

theorem double_toField_eq {a b c : Nat} (h : (a + b) % p = c % p) :
    (a : CurveField) + b = c := by
  have := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff' (a + b) c p).mpr h
  push_cast at this
  exact this

theorem double_toField_eq' {a c : Nat} (h : a % p = c % p) :
    (a : CurveField) = c :=
  (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff' a c p).mpr h
